messages:
Lena: Heads-up — Nimbus just escalated: they need SCIM user sync + provisioning in the MVP for their pilot next month. They say it's a dealbreaker.
Omar: What's their exact pilot date?
Lena: They want pilot kickoff June 7. That's ~5.5 weeks.
Casey: SCIM full sync (with incremental deltas, conflict resolution, audit) is ~3 sprints + infra work. We can't safely land that and keep other MVP promises.
Jin: What are the minimal enterprise expectations we can meet now?
Taylor: Minimal path = OIDC login + a manual invite flow + CSV bulk import for user onboarding. That avoids realtime SCIM and keeps most UX.
Lena: Nimbus prefers full automated provisioning but would accept a temporary admin import if we commit to SCIM in v1. They asked for a firm v1 ETA.
Omar: Can we firm v1 for end of Q3? Engineering: yes if we prioritize SCIM right after MVP and cut other v1 items.
Casey: Tradeoffs: to keep MVP date, we should remove advanced audit streams and admin delegation from MVP scope. Both can be v1.
Jin: That aligns with telemetry — audit streaming is heavy infra work. Admin delegation has low initial usage.
Taylor: Proposal: Ship MVP on time with OIDC + CSV import + lightweight admin UI. Commit to SCIM + delta sync + audit streaming in v1 (ETA: end of Q3). Add a temporary manual runbook for Nimbus.
Lena: Sounds good. Action items: Lena -> confirm with Nimbus and share the runbook; Casey -> update cutlist and backlog (mark audit & delegation as v1); Jin -> draft SCIM epic and rough timeline; Taylor -> build CSV import + admin UI spike (2 sprints).
deploy-bot: :bell: Note: code freeze window starts at 1769999800. Coordinate merges.
Omar: Acceptance criteria for MVP path: CSV import works for orgs up to 5k users, OIDC sign-in passes SAML fallback smoke tests, runbook validated with Nimbus SRE.
Taylor: Ill drop a quick smoke test curl example in the PO doc after this thread.
Lena: I'll schedule a 20-min sync with Nimbus leadership today 16:00 PT and update the customer comms.
